background.description: The theme's token of the pill's background, by its name, as "panel.bg" or "accent".

text.description: The theme's token of the pill's text, by its name.

border.description: The theme's token of the pill's border, by its name.

line.description: The theme's token of the hairline across the pane, by its name.

hover.description: The theme's token of the pill's background under the pointer, over its own, by its name.

font-size.description: The size of the header's text, in the terminal's font, in points; 0, or none, for the terminal's own size.

font-weight.description: The weight of the header's text, of the terminal's font's faces, the nearest that it has; regular is the terminal's own face.

padding-x.description: The room left and right of the text in the pill, in points.

padding-y.description: The room above and below the text in the pill, in points.

align.description: Where the header's pill sits along the hairline across the pane: a little in from its left, in its middle, or a little in from its right.
